title: The Walt Disney Company and OpenAI reach landmark agreement to bring beloved characters to Sora
summary: Disney and OpenAI have reached an agreement to bring more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora for fan-inspired short videos. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI in entertainment and includes Disney’s company-wide use of ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
body: Disney and OpenAI have reached an agreement to bring more than 200 Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars characters to Sora for fan-inspired short videos. The agreement emphasizes responsible AI in entertainment and includes Disney’s company-wide use of ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API.
summaryZh: 迪士尼与OpenAI达成战略合作，将超过200个迪士尼、漫威、皮克斯及星球大战的经典角色引入Sora视频生成模型。该协议不仅支持粉丝创作短视频，还涵盖了迪士尼全公司范围内对ChatGPT Enterprise及OpenAI API的部署，旨在推动娱乐产业的AI化转型并强调负责任的AI使用标准。
